pages.title: Getting started
pages.summary: Run Locket on your computer, finish setup as the owner, and add your first agreement.

pages.title: Move in from DocuSign
pages.summary: Bring completed DocuSign envelopes in with their signed PDFs and certificates, after a dry run that writes nothing.

pages.title: Back up and restore
pages.summary: Export the archive from the app, or the whole installation with rer, and restore it into an empty one.

pages.title: Requests and versions
pages.summary: Capture a request with its attachments, then negotiate in versions you can compare line by line.

pages.title: Review and approval
pages.summary: Review against your clause playbook and approve the exact version that will be signed.

pages.title: Signature and execution
pages.summary: Hand the approved version to the signing service you already use, then record the signed PDF and certificate.

pages.title: Terms, obligations and renewals
pages.summary: Confirm terms against the signed words, give obligations an owner, and decide each renewal before its notice deadline.

pages.title: People and roles
pages.summary: Invite people, give each one a role, and keep restricted agreements to the people who need them.

pages.title: Agents and the API
pages.summary: Let your own agent prepare proposals through the same API the screens use; people approve them.

pages.title: Run it locally
pages.summary: The rer commands for running, stopping, checking and resetting your installation, and where its data lives.
